scope: SDK two new files and direct wire validators; no Go/source execution

finding.behavior: Go encoding/json leaves a string zero value for null, so current SDK accepts and returns Files containing an invented empty string. A nonnil pointer/slice check does not reject null members.
finding.minimal_fix: Require each files member to be an actual JSON string while preserving valid empty strings; add this counterexample in existing root1.
finding.basis: Source tuple file names are strings; malformed transport metadata must not silently become a different successful tuple.

other_static_observations: Prepare/read/release stay under one capability and HostCaller; actual invocation ownership is a future host obligation, not proved by this SDK.
16MiB material uses at most sixteen 1MiB reads plus prepare/release; encoded page fits unchanged logical payload budget; actual transport not exercised by recording Host.
Exact handle/offset, declared total, final SHA and cleanup acknowledgment are checked; cleanup detaches cancellation only for bounded same-Host release.
None, empty string and nonnil empty bytes are represented distinctly. Source Python has no same 16MiB cap; no arbitrary-size parity is approved.
